_comment: Thin client wiring. One server, registered here as "psychology": a REMOTE server hosted on Cloud Run (part of the Service_system deployment, backed by Noesis) that holds ALL scoring logic, item banks, and the counselor-lookup integration. This client only ever sees tool/prompt schemas + results -- it contains NO Python source, NO scoring algorithms, NO item-bank content beyond what the server returns at runtime, and requires no local install of anything. AUTH: as of 2026-08-01 every tool call requires a Noesis personal access token (get one at https://noesis.seges.ai/connect -- sign in, agree to the terms, token is issued once). This file supplies it via the 'headers' field above, interpolating the NOESIS_PAT environment variable -- set NOESIS_PAT to your token BEFORE installing/connecting this server (e.g. 'claude mcp add ... --env NOESIS_PAT=<token>', or export it in your shell first); Claude Code does not prompt for missing env vars, it just fails to connect, so this must be set upfront. See README.md's Authentication section for the full step-by-step. URL HISTORY: the connector lived at connect.noesis.seges.ai until 2026-08-03, when the site, MCP endpoint, and REST API were unified behind the branded noesis.seges.ai domain (Cloudflare worker; the old connect. subdomain is being retired). A Google-OAuth-gated sibling server (noesis_mcp_gated, RFC 9728 + OAuth 2.1 + PKCE via fastmcp's GoogleProvider) is BUILT and unit-tested but NOT live: it still needs a dedicated Google OAuth 2.0 Web Client created and wired into deploy config. See noesis-system/README.md's Authentication section and Service_system's noesis_mcp_gated/README.md. This file will point at the gated URL once a real end-to-end OAuth login has been verified -- not before.
